title: ADR-0028: sandbox-runtime replaces hand-written seatbelt profiles

content.summary: The fleet now confines its processes with **sandbox-runtime (srt)** instead of hand-written seatbelt profiles: each process starts default-deny and reaches only the hosts its settings name.

sections.h: We pay for srt with wider reads and two places for policy

rows: Reads reach any file under the code roots that is not secret-shaped
Egress is pinned to named hosts
The egress policy lives in two places: the settings file and the wrapper that names per-machine hosts.
A wrapper change gets the same review as a policy change.

blocks.text: srt globs cannot express "prose and Go files only", so a token in a YAML config under the code roots is readable too. The calling agent reads the same files.
